sql.query: SELECT d.id,d.deliveryMethod,d.deliveryStatus,d.recipientName,d.recipientEmail,d.subjectSnapshot,d.pdfFileNameSnapshot,d.pdfSha256Snapshot,d.sentDate,d.notes,d.createdDate,COALESCE(u.displayName,'Unknown') recordedBy FROM tbl_contract_deliveries d INNER JOIN tbl_generated_contracts gc ON gc.id=d.contractId AND gc.tenantId=d.tenantId LEFT JOIN tbl_users u ON u.id=d.createdByUserId WHERE d.contractId=:contractId AND d.tenantId=:tenantId AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles utr WHERE utr.userId=:userId AND utr.tenantId=d.tenantId AND utr.isActive=1) ORDER BY d.sentDate DESC,d.id DESC
